key_insight: Self-supervised JEPA embeddings capture crystallographic structure in powder XRD patterns and show emergent representations of peak broadening and multi-phase mixtures.
engineering_relevance: Frozen JEPA representations could support automated XRD analysis in high-throughput materials workflows with lightweight task-specific probes.
method: Learn embeddings from 1D diffraction patterns using a Joint Embedding Predictive Architecture.
Optimize masked self-prediction directly in latent space.
Evaluate frozen representations with lightweight attentive probes and latent-space decoding.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports space group classification and lattice parameter estimation accuracy close to much larger supervised vision transformers, plus realistic mixture patterns decoded along latent paths between single-phase representations.
watch_item: Realistic decoded mixtures do not establish reliable phase identification or quantification on experimental multi-phase XRD data.
paper_title: Exploring Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures for Self-Supervised Representation Learning of Powder X-ray Diffraction Patterns
